title: Tribute to burn — Mass Driver / Catapult Turtle

cards.name: Mass Driver
cards.officialText: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field to inflict 400 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

cards.name: Catapult Turtle
cards.officialText: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the Tributed monster's ATK on the field.

behavior.damage: floor(current ATK / 2); original ATK for face-down Tribute

design.cost: Tribute is paid at activation and remains paid if the activation is negated.
design.ownership: The monster is removed from the controlling team's Monster Zone and sent to the Graveyard of the physical owner encoded by UID m0–m3.
design.control: Only monsters currently controlled by the source team may be Tributed; the damage is applied to the opposing shared LP pool.
design.attack: Catapult Turtle uses current ATK at the moment of Tribute when face-up; face-down uses original printed ATK.
design.limits: Mass Driver has no once-per-turn text; Catapult Turtle is once per physical copy/turn. Host must call resetCatapultSoftOncePerTurn when the copy leaves the field or is flipped face-down.
design.source: Mass Driver must remain face-up/resolved through resolution; Catapult Turtle's already activated effect resolves even if the source leaves the field, unless activation/effect is negated.

limits: Não conecta os efeitos ao resolver central, comandos Discord, persistência ou allowlist.
O host deve informar negação da ativação e chamar resetCatapultSoftOncePerTurn em saída do campo/flip face-down.
Catapult Turtle e Mass Driver permanecem fora do catálogo e da certificação; o adapter é apenas uma implementação isolada de comportamento.
Mass Driver está Forbidden no TCG atual e Catapult Turtle está Forbidden no OCG atual; nenhuma regra de banlist foi alterada.
